description: The recent news that House District 99 will be represented by an unaffiliated member for the remainder of this term is a significant moment for our community. However, the most important voice in this conversation has already been heard: Yours!!In March, District 99 sent a clear and powerful message by choosing a new direction for our future. True leadership isn't just about a title or personal "principles" it’s about a deep, unwavering commitment to the people you are chosen to represent. When
